profile.name: EPICS仪器服务器
profile.description: 这是一个用于实验室控制系统的EPICS仪器服务组件，用于连接仪器数据库并发布或更新仪器名称、位置名称、运动状态、信息消息和时间戳等过程变量。它更像是实验自动化系统中的控制服务，而不是独立的物理仪器。
profile.description_en: This is an EPICS-based laboratory instrument service component that attaches to an instrument database and publishes or updates process variables such as instrument name, position name, motion state, info messages, and timestamps. It is better described as a control service within a lab automation system rather than a standalone physical instrument.

registry.name: Epics Instrument
registry.description: Epics Instrument Server是由EPICS (Argonne National Lab)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括启动、运动控制。
